values.note: 2026 Peak Season (May 22 - Oct 25): $30 a night for RV, standard and tent sites alike; group sites $45.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233369/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-10-25: RV NONELECTRIC 30, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 30, group 45) + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis at a fee of $30 per night'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233369 (notice: 'There are no showers. No electric, water or sewer hook-ups are available.'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233369 ('flush toilets, drinking water and a dump station'; 'There are no showers') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('All campgrounds have potable water, comfort stations with flush toilets and sinks, and a dump station'; showers only at Julian Price and Mount Pisgah), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: 33 sites for advance reservation and 70 first-come, plus three group sites; its catalog lists 25 RV sites, 49 standard and 45 tent-only. RV sites are back-ins of 20-43 ft, most 35 ft or more, with one 88-ft pull-through; no maximum recorded.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233369 ('In addition to the 33 sites available for advance reservation, 70 campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'Three group sites') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (type, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 33 sites reservable up to six months ahead; 70 first-come sites are booked in person at the campground kiosk and are not tracked online. Stay limit 30 consecutive days and 30 days a year.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233369 ('70 campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis... These sites must be booked in person at the campground kiosk'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 30, maxStay 30 days Each Year) + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Reservations can be made up to six months in advance by visiting www.recreation.gov'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: NPS: the parkway's eight campgrounds are open from May through late October, weather permitting, and closed in winter. Reservations ran to October 25 in 2026.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('The parkway's eight campgrounds are open from May through late October, weather permitting. They are closed in winter.') + recreation.gov availability Oct 2026 (sites reservable through 2026-10-25, 'Not Available' from 10-26), read 2026-10-22

status.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/233369/month (Oct 2026: sites Reserved/Available through Oct 25) + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/roadclosures.htm (MP 229.7-241.1 'US-21 to Doughton Park Recreation Area and The Bluffs Restaurant: Open'; Helene closures listed only for Linville Falls and Crabtree Falls campgrounds), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS-run, open in 2026 (not on the parkway's Helene closure list; season ends Oct 25). Confirmed $30 (2026). Added no hookups, no showers, flush toilets/water/dump, 33 reservable + 70 first-come sites (kiosk), one pull-through, 6-month window, 30-night limit, season May-late October. Not stated: exact opening/closing dates (NPS API rate-limited; the nps.gov campground page loads its data by script), senior pass discount.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov facility phone 336-372-8877 (May - October); parkway headquarters 828-348-3400.

Access caution (no 4WD issue): recreation.gov warns 'GPS devices and mapping programs may take campers onto steep grades and gravel or dirt country roads not suitable for RV or trailer travel' - come in by the Parkway from US-21 (or US-421/NC-18).

inclusion_evidence says 108 sites incl 24 RV sites max 43 ft; recreation.gov's description gives 33 reservable + 70 first-come + 3 group, and its catalog lists 25 RV sites (back-ins 20-43 ft plus one 88-ft pull-through). Fits a 23-ft rig either way.
